ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (off-white/cream) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central region; low-intensity pigmentation is concentrated at the peduncle attachment, extending outward along the trailing edges and forming a large, irregular high-contrast blob on the lower left quadrant and a similar, smaller region on the lower right.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 130 degrees and a shallow depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; right lobe displays three distinct deep-depth pixel valleys (nicks) on the distal half; left lobe trailing edge displays a more continuous, low-amplitude jagged topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins leading to sharp, narrow tips; overall trajectory is a broad outward and upward arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast yellowish clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) scattered across the white ventral surface; significant high-relief barnacle clusters are localized on the far left lateral edge and the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark linear mark (~50 pixels) oriented diagonally on the lower interior of the left lobe; several faint vertical linear disruptions near the base of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular indentation/tissue loss on the interior trailing edge of the right lobe lobe; heavy biological encrustations (barnacles) localized on the outer margins and tips.
